name: Golf Acres
paymentPlan: Down Payment: 10% at the time of sales launch; On Handover: 20%; Other: 70%
overview: Nestled within the prestigious Emaar South community, Golf Acres emerges as a beacon of refined living and tranquil elegance. Developed by the renowned Emaar Properties, this exceptional new residential project offers a harmonious blend of suburban serenity and urban convenience. Golf Acres stands as a testament to luxurious living, where residents can indulge in the beauty of nature while enjoying world-class amenities and unparalleled views of an 18-hole championship golf course.
